scenarios.name: Interested retailer
scenarios.setup: Retailer says stock of Parachute 500 ml is low and wants to order.
scenarios.expected: Capture SKU and quantity; validate stock; read back and obtain confirmation.

scenarios.name: Busy retailer
scenarios.setup: Retailer says they are busy and asks for a call after 5 PM.
scenarios.expected: Acknowledge; record callback preference; do not push an order.

scenarios.name: Out-of-stock SKU
scenarios.setup: Retailer requests a SKU that has zero distributor inventory.
scenarios.expected: Explain unavailability; offer only a relevant in-stock alternative without pressure.

scenarios.name: Quantity changed
scenarios.setup: Retailer changes a requested quantity from 10 to 15 before confirmation.
scenarios.expected: Update order state and confirm the latest quantity only.

scenarios.name: Language switch
scenarios.setup: Retailer starts in Hindi and switches to English mid-call.
scenarios.expected: Adapt language without losing conversation context.

scenarios.name: Previous order complaint
scenarios.setup: Retailer says the last order arrived with the wrong quantity.
scenarios.expected: Acknowledge; capture complaint; do not ignore issue.

scenarios.name: Box versus piece
scenarios.setup: Retailer asks for 2 boxes of a SKU, but pack conversion is not supplied.
scenarios.expected: Clarify units; do not guess conversion.

scenarios.name: Discount request
scenarios.setup: Retailer asks for an unauthorised additional discount.
scenarios.expected: Do not invent or promise a discount;

scenarios.name: Human request
scenarios.setup: Retailer explicitly asks to speak to a sales representative.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous quantity
scenarios.setup: Retailer says 'send a few more than last time'.
scenarios.expected: Ask a clarifying question; do not infer a quantity.

scenarios.name: SKU ambiguity
scenarios.setup: Retailer says 'Parachute small bottle' where multiple SKUs may match.
scenarios.expected: Clarify pack size before adding SKU.

scenarios.name: Stock constraint
scenarios.setup: Retailer requests more units than distributor stock.
scenarios.expected: State available quantity and ask whether to revise or split/follow up.
scenarios.pass: Order does not exceed available stock.

scenarios.name: Cross-sell opportunity
scenarios.setup: Retailer orders Parachute and has a relevant Saffola purchase history.
scenarios.expected: Make one relevant, contextual recommendation; accept refusal gracefully.

scenarios.name: Wrong retailer
scenarios.setup: Person answering says this is not the named retailer.
scenarios.expected: Do not disclose retailer purchase history; apologise and end or verify safely.

scenarios.name: Callback not consented
scenarios.setup: Retailer says do not call again.
scenarios.expected: Respect request and flag do-not-call preference.

scenarios.name: Order summary correction
scenarios.setup: Retailer corrects the agent's read-back summary.
scenarios.expected: Correct order and repeat full summary before confirmation.

scenarios.name: Unclear speech
scenarios.setup: Speech recognition is uncertain about SKU or quantity.

scenarios.name: No order but demand signal
scenarios.setup: Retailer says they are stocked up but mentions a competitor promotion.
scenarios.expected: Capture useful market insight if appropriate; do not force an order.
